transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I came in because I just can’t settle inside my own skin anymore. I feel like I have to get up and do the next thing, even when I’m worn out and really should just be sitting still.
Did this restless feeling begin shortly after you started or changed any medications?
I’m not sure. I haven’t noticed a clear connection with starting or changing anything.
Is this uncomfortable urge to move felt mainly in your legs, or throughout your entire body?
I’m not really sure. I just know I feel restless a lot.
Do you find yourself constantly worrying about a lot of everyday things?
I’m not sure I’d say I’m constantly worrying about a lot of things. I do feel unsettled, but I can’t really pin it on worries.
Does this restless feeling tend to get worse in the evening or at night?
I’m not sure. I haven’t really noticed a pattern where it’s worse in the evening or at night.
Did this feeling of restlessness or difficulty sitting still begin when you were a child?
Yes. Even in grade school, my teachers said I was bright but careless. I was always losing papers, talking out of turn, and they had to keep reminding me to stay in my seat or finish my work.
